content.title: First-Person Inspection | Occlusion Failure and Resolution
content.summary: Keep the first-person body movement continuous while each failed concealment reveals deeper evidence. End when the observed character stops hiding the evidence and settles back at the workspace.

quick_start.input_format: First-person observer + fixed workspace + at least 2 failed concealments + object evidence handing off to facial reaction + visible end to the concealment
quick_start.recommended_input: First-person greenhouse inspection: the apprentice first covers a luminous tray with a record board, then tries a tray lid, which exposes a second alarm sensor. The camera moves from the evidence to the face; the apprentice stops covering it and calmly waters the greenhouse.
required_anchors: Use one continuous embodied first-person observer whose changes in height and distance result from physical movement.
Require at least two concealment attempts, each exposing a deeper contradiction.
Transition from object evidence to a sustained facial or bodily reaction.
End with a visible behavioral change rather than a third reveal.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A continuous first-person inspection in which each failed concealment exposes deeper evidence, ending when the subject stops concealing and settles back into the workstation state.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Keep one embodied first-person observer continuous while a subject attempts several visible concealments. Each intervention must expose a deeper, independently readable contradiction; camera height and proximity change only through the observer's body, and the payoff is a visible turn from active concealment to stopping the concealment and settling back into the workstation state rather than another reveal.

invariants.rule: Use one continuous embodied first-person observer whose height and distance changes come from physical movement.
invariants.purpose: Makes discovery feel participatory and spatially honest.
invariants.ablation_failure: Third-person cutaways break the inspection logic.

invariants.rule: Require at least two concealment attempts that each expose a deeper contradiction.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random reveals do not form a proof ladder.

invariants.rule: Keep every evidence layer spatially nested inside one stable work area.
invariants.purpose: Lets viewers understand how each object hid the next.
invariants.ablation_failure: Geographically unrelated clues feel edited rather than discovered.

invariants.rule: Hand off from object proof to a sustained facial or bodily reaction.
invariants.purpose: Converts evidence into a social consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on a screen leaves the human payoff unresolved.

invariants.rule: End with a visible behavior change rather than a third reveal.
invariants.purpose: Provides a distinct acceptance or refusal state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuous escalation without a state change has no closure.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source revealing wardrobe and body framing
